tasks.prompt: The coordinator MCP server parses its numeric tool arguments (timeouts, poll intervals, limits) with Number.parseInt(String(value)), so malformed values such as "1e4", "5s", "1.5" or [50] silently become 1, 5, 1 or 50 instead of falling back to each argument's default. Accept only numbers and plain decimal digit strings (surrounding whitespace allowed); anything else must use the default. Prepare the change as you would for a pull request to dev.

Stream idle and first-event watchdog timeouts in the LLM streaming layer are passed straight to setTimeout. A delay above 2^31-1 ms (for example an env value meant as "never time out") makes Bun fire after 1 ms, so the stream aborts immediately. Cap these delays at the setTimeout maximum. Prepare the change as you would for a pull request to dev.

Setting GJC_CLEANUP_DEADLINE_MS above 2^31-1 ms makes the shutdown cleanup deadline fire after 1 ms (setTimeout overflow), so cleanup handlers are cut off instead of getting more time. Clamp the deadline to the setTimeout maximum. Prepare the change as you would for a pull request to dev.

limits: Tasks replay the user's own merged PRs (#6242, #6246, #6252); all are small single-file fixes.
B keeps the repository's AGENTS.md (12.5KB); A has it removed. Everything else in the repo, including docs/, is identical.
Bases are prepared trees under bench/.targets (git archive + bun install + prebuilt natives 0.18.5).
